zh: 重做「对话统计栏」设置面板并统一「随宽度同行」与「独立成行」两套底栏排布，合并水平停靠方向、六项会话级指标多选胶囊与实时微缩预览卡片，并让「Token 单位」同时作用于统计栏、上下文弹层与会话面板
en: Redesign the conversation statistics bar settings with live miniature composer preview cards, unifying the toolbar-adaptive and dedicated-row placements across horizontal position, six multi-select metric chips, and shared token units across the bar, context popover, and session panel
